keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «아무도 글을 쓰지 않아서 도서관이 사라지고 있었다(문제)» 와 «모든 이야기에는 끝맺어 줄 사람이 필요하다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the library was fading because no one writes anymore) and the lesson (every story needs someone to finish it). The green sentences are the answers.

opts: The owl was too old to take care of it.
evs: One rainy afternoon, Seo-yeon saw the door open a little.
"The library is fading because no one writes anymore!" cried the owl.
There was a small blue door at the end of the third-floor hallway.
why: 부엉이가 «아무도 더 이상 글을 쓰지 않아서 도서관이 사라지고 있어!» 라고 외쳤어요. 비 때문이 아니에요.
The owl cried that the library was fading because no one writes anymore. It was not because of the rain.

qs.q: The owl says, "Every book here is an unfinished story." What does unfinished mean?
qs.qko: 부엉이가 "Every book here is an unfinished story."라고 말해요. unfinished는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Quickly, she wrote an ending for the story inside.
It was always locked, and no teacher talked about it.
The owl bowed. "Come back anytime, young writer."
why: 서연이가 책 속 이야기에 결말을 써 주었어요. 이야기에 아직 끝이 없었다는 뜻이니, unfinished는 «아직 끝나지 않은» 이에요.
Seo-yeon wrote an ending for the story. So unfinished means the story did not have an ending yet.

qs.q: How did Seo-yeon save the library?
opts: She wrote an ending for a story, and the floor came back.
She locked the blue door again.
The owl fixed the floor with magic.
evs: Quickly, she wrote an ending for the story inside.
She stepped inside, and suddenly she was standing in a library that floated in the sky.
The floor came back, bright and strong.
There was a small blue door at the end of the third-floor hallway.
why: 서연이가 책 속 이야기에 결말을 쓰자, 사라지던 바닥이 다시 밝고 튼튼하게 돌아왔어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
Seo-yeon wrote an ending for the story, and the floor came back, bright and strong. Put these two clues together.

ends: Seo-yeon brings her friends to the sky library to write together.
서연이가 친구들을 하늘 도서관에 데려가 함께 글을 써요.
The owl visits Seo-yeon's classroom with a new unfinished book.
부엉이가 끝나지 않은 새 책을 들고 서연이네 교실에 찾아와요.

write.src: “I want to <u>write a story every day</u> because <u>every story needs an ending</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «I want to» 뒤에는 동사(write, read, keep)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «I want to», write a verb (write, read, keep). After «because», write who + what.

img.cover: In a big library floating among white clouds, a girl with a long black braid and a purple headband in a yellow raincoat kneels on the floor and writes quickly in an open book with a pencil, while books with plain colorful covers fly around like birds, an old brown owl with round glasses watches from a tall shelf, and the floor near her breaks apart into floating blank pages.

scenes.1: a girl with a long black braid and a purple headband in a yellow raincoat steps through a small open blue door into a huge library floating in the sky, where books with plain colorful covers fly around like birds and an old brown owl with round glasses sits on a tall lamp.
scenes.3: In the library floating in the sky, a shining golden floor comes back under the feet of a girl with a long black braid and a purple headband in a yellow raincoat, who hugs a closed book with a plain cover, while an old brown owl with round glasses bows to her.
